title: ASCenD-BDS: Adaptable, Stochastic and Context-aware framework for Detection of Bias, Discrimination and Stereotyping
reasoning: The framework developed in this paper (ASCenD-BDS) explicitly identifies 'Religion' as one of its ten core categories for detecting and benchmarking bias, discrimination, and stereotyping in Large Language Models. It includes religion-based variations and scenarios as a component of its evaluative content.
